mountain-thane.title: Mountain Thane key points
items: Line up {Avatar} with big trash pulls and use it with the 2 {Thunder Blast} charges
Keep {Shield Block} up even while bursting. Main tank busters: {busters}

colossus.title: Colossus key points
items: Tank busters to take with {Shield Block} up: {busters}
Use {Demolish} after building {Colossal Might}; timed with a knockback mechanic, you won't get pushed

Rav'i: [탱버] Hydrastrike is physical damage from three heads striking in a row, so block it with Shield Block and layer Ignore Pain. Topicx (a Protection Warrior) says this boss barely threatens a Protection Warrior, so save Shield Wall.
[탱버] Pre-cast Spell Reflection every time Triple Shot (116379 Nature + 5 yd DoT) goes out. If you are targeted, it gets reflected and only two circles remain, which eases healing (Topicx).
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry for the Ravenous Stomp AoE (145474 Nature to the party) (Topicx).
[참고] Throw Wrecking Throw (up to 500% bonus damage to absorbs) into each Ssscavenging shield and line up Avatar (1.5 min) with every shield (Topicx).
The Writhing Coil: [탱버] Block Tail Scythe (3 sec cast, 678877 Physical) with Shield Block. Topicx (a Protection Warrior) says it doesn't hurt the tank much.
[차단] Put Pummel into the kick order for the three Toxic Atrophy casts during Toxic Barrage.

[제어] During Uncoil, kite the Uncoiled Writhes together, stun them with Shockwave, and use Avatar to boost damage in the split phase. Once the Writhes are within 14 yd, interrupt their Toxic Atrophy all at once with Disrupting Shout.
Zul'jan: [탱버] For Chop Down (1.5 sec cast, two 484912 Physical hits), keep Shield Block up and spend one Shield Wall charge on each. Without a charge, use Demoralizing Shout and Last Stand. Each Chop Down clears 2 stacks of Ritual Venom (Topicx).
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry during the Ritual of the Fang beam-soak channel (Topicx).
[위치] If your beam spot is far, Heroic Leap there before Ritual of the Fang starts.

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Bedrock Slam is mostly physical (484912 Physical + 193965 Nature). It lands soon after you finish soaking Lightblossom Beam and step out of Fertile Loam, so put up Shield Block, layer Ignore Pain, and add Shield Wall on high keys.
[차단] Pummel Kezkitt's Light Bolt, and if Pummel is on cooldown, stop it with Wrecking Throw (3 sec silence via Javelineer).
[위치] If the three bosses drift apart, hold threat with Taunt and stack them back up.
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Bloodthorn Roots is a magic effect, but warriors can't dispel magic from allies. Drag the boss next to the rooted ally and break the roots with Thunder Clap and Revenge.
[위치] Before Verdant Stomp (145474 Physical + knockback), pull the boss out of the root zone. On the Colossus build, channel Demolish into the 3 sec cast to be immune to the knockback.

[탱버] From Lightcrazed Frenzy at 50%, Holy AoE pulses until death, so when it overlaps the Nature damage of Thorncaller Roar, use Shield Wall or Last Stand and cut magic damage by 20% with Spell Reflection.
Lightwarden Ruia: [탱버] Warden's Wrath in Moonkin Form is repeated Nature (magic) damage on the tank, so Shield Block does nothing. Pummel it, and take any missed cast with Ignore Pain and Spell Reflection.

[탱버] In Bear Form, Mangling Claws doubles melee damage, so keep Shield Block rolling and layer Demoralizing Shout. The Grievous Thrash bleed only clears at full health, so top yourself off with Impending Victory.
[탱버] After Spirits of the Vale at 40%, split both Shield Wall charges and Last Stand across the phase.
Ziekket: [탱버] Thornspike is 193965 Holy plus a 10 sec physical bleed (58189 per sec), so Shield Block (melee only) does not reduce it. When you see the 3 sec cast, stack Ignore Pain and press Spell Reflection.
[차단] When Lashers spawn, step into the middle of the pack and use Disrupting Shout to grab threat and interrupt their pre-revive Lightspore Shot at once. Pummel the remaining casts.
[제어] Stun pre-revive Lashers all at once with Shockwave to stop their casts. Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts and crowd control, so kill them fast with AoE.

The Hoardmonger: [탱버] Ravenous Bellow and Hearty Bellow (3 sec cast, armor-ignoring 164870 Physical to all + 10 sec DoT) are not melee attacks, so Shield Block does nothing. Stack Ignore Pain and press Demoralizing Shout when you see the cast. This boss doesn't hit the tank hard, so save Shield Wall (Topicx).
[위치] Reach far mushrooms with Heroic Leap (Bounding Stride gives 70% movement speed for 3 sec), then bring the boss back to the middle of the room (Topicx).
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry when Bellows overlap and the party is low.
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Pummel Winter's Shroud from the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss that you and the melee handle. If the ranged side misses theirs, stop it with Wrecking Throw (30 yd and a 3 sec silence via Javelineer).
[탱버] If you get hit by Frozen Tempest (Frost) outside Snowdrift, cut magic damage by 20% with Spell Reflection and press Shield Wall.
[위치] If no one can soak Rimeshatter, soak it yourself and heal up with Impending Victory.
Nalorakk: [탱버] Use Shield Wall and layer Demoralizing Shout for Overwhelming Onslaught (armor-ignoring 315193 Physical x3 + knockback). Topicx (a Protection Warrior) says this is where the tank's defensive goes.
[탱버] Stack Ignore Pain as you step in after the knockback to soak Forceful Slam (5 sec cast, 775859 Physical within 6 yd), and use Last Stand if Shield Wall is down.

[탱버] If you are targeted by Echoing Maul, press Spell Reflection for the Nature damage (193965) when the Echo lands. When Echoing Fury stacks during Fury of the War God, heal up with Impending Victory.

Kystia Manaheart: [탱버] Chaos Barrage (3 sec cast, 290947 Chaos) hits the tank all fight, so press Spell Reflection on cooldown. Topicx (a Protection Warrior) says it reflects about every fourth cast.
[탱버] Take the Chaos Barrages you can't reflect with Ignore Pain. Three in a row is dangerous, so press Shield Wall (8 sec) right before one lands to cover two (Topicx).
[차단] Interrupt the Mirror Images' Felstorm all at once with Disrupting Shout, and stop any leftover images with Pummel and Shockwave.
Zaen Bladesorrow: [탱버] The worker pack you drag in hits hard right at the start, so put up Shield Block and use Shield Wall (Topicx).

[탱버] When you see Envenom (3 sec cast, 436421 Physical + Heartstop Poison), press Spell Reflection. Topicx (a Protection Warrior) reflects every cast and never takes Heartstop Poison. Block the physical damage with Shield Block.
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry for Killing Spree (armor-ignoring party Physical over 3 sec). On high keys, decide in advance who covers which Killing Spree (Topicx).
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] For Legion Strike (3 sec cast, 533403 Physical, 80% less healing taken for 8 sec), keep Shield Block up and use Shield Wall. Topicx (a Protection Warrior) says it doesn't hit a Protection Warrior very hard, so without a charge, take it with Shield Block and Ignore Pain.
[탱버] Demonic Rage gives the boss 75% attack speed for 15 sec, so keep Shield Block rolling and layer Demoralizing Shout (45 sec) and Last Stand.
[광역 피해] Use Demoralizing Shout for the Infernal Crush window after Axe Toss, and Rallying Cry on the Colossus build (Topicx).
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Pummel Chaos Bolt (3 sec cast). If Pummel is on cooldown, stop it with Storm Bolt.

[제어] When Wild Imps and the Furious Vilefiend spawn, interrupt and lock them down with Disrupting Shout and Shockwave, then press Avatar (1.5 min) (Topicx). Disrupting Shout near the green wall can taunt mobs on the other side, so step away from the wall first (Topicx).
[탱버] Take Furious Vilefiend's Shadow Bite shadow damage with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain. Use Heroic Leap when relocating to another corner away from the Infernal.

Taz'Rah: [위치] Stand in the middle of the room before the boss appears, and Taunt it the moment it lands (Topicx).

[탱버] Reflect every Void Blast (2 sec cast, 271551 Shadow + knockback) with Spell Reflection. Topicx (a Protection Warrior) calls it one of the best reflects of the season. When Spell Reflection is on cooldown, stack Ignore Pain and use Shield Wall or Last Stand.
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry for the Dark Bloom party damage (Topicx).
Atroxus: [탱버] Use Spell Reflection and Shield Wall together for Hulking Claw (2 sec cast, 242456 Nature + 10 sec Nature DoT). On casts with no Shield Wall charge, cover with Demoralizing Shout, a health potion, and Impending Victory (Topicx).
[회피] When Toxic Creeper closes in, slow it with Piercing Howl (24 yd radius with Battlefield Commander, 70% snare), and Heroic Leap away if it is about to catch you.
[참고] Tank damage peaks while Toxic Creeper is up, so press Avatar (1.5 min) on the Creeper to help kill it fast.
Charonus: [탱버] Overlap Spell Reflection and Shield Wall for Dark Waves (5 sec cast, 339438 Shadow frontal). Don't spend tank defensives on Cosmic Crash (Topicx).
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry while DPS drag Gravitic Orbs through the puddles (Topicx).
[위치] Hold threat with Taunt while moving the boss in front of two Singularities, and turn toward the empty side when you see the Dark Waves cast.

The Golden Serpent: [탱버] Make sure Shield Block is up when Tail Thrash is cast.
[차단] Lock down Animated Gold packs heading for the boss with Shockwave or Storm Bolt, and slow them with Piercing Howl.
[위치] Use Heroic Leap to reposition quickly when dragging the boss away from the gold piles.
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Pummel the mummies' Wretched Discharge first, and use Disrupting Shout if there are several.
[위치] If woken mummies scatter, gather threat with Challenging Shout and bring them next to the boss.
[위치] During the Entomb coffin search, Heroic Leap to reach coffins on the far side quickly.
The Council of Tribes: [탱버] Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand (727368 Physical, 2 sec cast) knocks you back and applies Shattered Defenses, which raises physical damage taken by 200% for 10 sec. Use Shield Wall (8 sec) before the cast to cover the Backhand and the melee that follows, the second charge on the next Backhand, and Last Stand on the one after.
[위치] If both Shield Wall and Last Stand are on cooldown, walk away from Aka'ali and kite until Shattered Defenses ends, using Heroic Leap to gain more distance.
[탱버] From the moment Zanazal is engaged, Arc Lightning (135775 Nature, 1 sec cast) hits the tank first, and Shield Block does nothing against it. Stack Ignore Pain and press Spell Reflection.
[차단] Assign Pummel to Poison Nova (4 sec cast, 12 sec poison DoT) and make sure it lands.
Dazar, The First King: [탱버] After 80%, when T'zala's Savage Maul (193965 Physical plus a 10 sec bleed and 10% more physical damage taken) lands, use Shield Wall before the Blade Combo that follows. Use the second charge on the next overlap and Last Stand on the one after; if all are on cooldown, use Demoralizing Shout.
[탱버] Shield Block can't stop the Savage Maul bleed, so stack Ignore Pain, and block the Blade Combo melee strikes with Shield Block.
[차단] Assign Pummel to Reban's Deathly Roar (4 sec cast, Shadow AoE and 4 sec fear), and if you get feared, break it at once with Berserker Rage (1 min).
[위치] Grab T'zala with Taunt as soon as it joins at 80%.

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Pummel Frigid Shard right after the Hailburst ice drops and drag the boss out of the ice. If Pummel is on cooldown, stop it with Wrecking Throw (3 sec silence via Javelineer).
[탱버] A missed Frigid Shard is a 775859 Physical spell launched from range, so take it with Ignore Pain and Shield Wall rather than relying on Shield Block.

[우선 처치] When Ice Bulwark goes up in the 66% and 33% intermissions, throw Wrecking Throw (up to 500% bonus damage to absorbs), and gather the Infused Whelps with Challenging Shout and hit them with Thunder Clap. Line up Avatar with the pull and each intermission.

[해제] Warriors on the M+ builds can't clear Cold Claws stacks, so leave the dispel to your party, use Demoralizing Shout on the whelp pack, and kill it fast. On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry in the intermission.
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] For Searing Blows (4 physical hits over 3 sec, each applying a stacking 8 sec Fire DoT), use Shield Block and Spell Reflection together. On high keys, alternate Shield Wall and Demoralizing Shout on top of Spell Reflection.
[차단] Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley hits the whole party, so Pummel it.
[참고] If the Searing Wounds Fire DoT drains your health, heal yourself with Impending Victory.
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [탱버] Take Stormslam (387930 Physical + 193965 Nature) with only Shield Block and Ignore Pain, and save Shield Wall and Last Stand for Inferno Spit explosions and phase 2.
[탱버] If you are an Inferno Spit target, press Spell Reflection or Shield Wall the moment the circle expires and explodes.

[해제] Stormslam's Nature vulnerability (100% more Nature damage taken) is magic and warriors can't dispel it, so leave it to your healer before the next Stormslam. If it is still on you, press Spell Reflection for Interrupting Cloudburst.

Adderis & Aspix: [탱버] When Adderis gains Overload (8 sec of double attack speed, melee adds 25% Nature damage), keep Shield Block up and press Spell Reflection. If it overlaps and your health drops, use Last Stand.
[위치] Keep the bosses near the middle of the room, and when Gale Force pushes you away, Charge (20 sec) straight back to the boss (Topicx).
[참고] If the party is in danger during the Thunder and Lightning soak, use Rallying Cry (Colossus build).
Merektha: [탱버] Lightning Bite (533403 Physical plus a 7 sec Nature DoT, 3 sec cast) can be reflected with Spell Reflection (in the Topicx video it took 3% of the boss's health). Press Spell Reflection on each cast with Ignore Pain, and when it's on cooldown take it with Shield Block and Last Stand.
[제어] Free a party member caught in A Knot of Snakes by stunning the knot with Storm Bolt, then gather the freed snakes with Challenging Shout and hit them with Thunder Clap.
[참고] Use Rallying Cry on the Colossus build for Serpentstorm (Nature knockback and 8 sec DoT).
[차단] Pummel the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit.
Galvazzt: [위치] Each time Induction Field appears, Heroic Leap to the next corner first and drag the boss after you.
[참고] Nothing here targets the tank, so save Shield Wall and Last Stand for the Orb Watchers' Venomous Slash that follows.
Avatar of Sethraliss: [위치] When a Corrupted Guardian spawns on the purple mark, Charge in to grab it right away, and Taunt the Twisted Hexxer over to stack it next to the Guardian.
[탱버] Use Shield Wall and Spell Reflection together for Tainted Strike (484912 Physical plus a stacking 25 sec Shadow DoT) (Topicx), and take the casts in between with Shield Block and Ignore Pain.
[차단] Pummel the Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock.
[제어] Slow the Faithless Tormentors chasing your healer with Piercing Howl and stun them all at once with Shockwave. Use Storm Bolt on any one left over.

1: [탱버] For Virid Grovekeeper's Earthrupture Strike (533403 Physical, 2.5 sec cast), keep Shield Block up and spend one Shield Wall charge. Both M+ builds take Defender's Aegis, so Shield Wall has 2 charges at 2 min each; save the second charge for the Virid Grovekeeper in pull 3.

[차단] When Radiant Spellsower casts Light Bolt Volley from range, stop it with Wrecking Throw (45 sec, 30 yd and a 3 sec silence via Javelineer) so it walks to you. If it runs to a Lasher group with Call The Grove, stun it for 4 sec with Storm Bolt.
2: [탱버] No Virid Grovekeeper here, so save Shield Wall for pull 3. Take Spouting Floret with Ignore Pain and Spell Reflection, and use Last Stand (3 min) if your health runs low.
[차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley together, wait until both are within 14 yd and interrupt them at once with Disrupting Shout (1.5 min), which also taunts them.
3: [탱버] Use the second Shield Wall charge you saved in pull 1 on Earthrupture Strike. The first charge only returns 2 min after you used it in pull 1.
[탱버] When a Lightgorged Lasher casts Lightbloom Pollination, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed from Pollen Surge, so keep Shield Block rolling and layer Demoralizing Shout.
5: [탱버] Take the first-pulled Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain, then use Shield Block and Shield Wall on Earthrupture Strike from the Virid Grovekeeper you pull 5-6 sec later.
[제어] When a Thorny Saptor jumps in with Thornclaw Leap, stun it for 4 sec with Storm Bolt to stop its follow-up frontal attacks.
[위치] On the Colossus build, channel Demolish (2 sec) into the Uproot cast (3 sec) to be immune to the knockback and hold your spot.
7: [탱버] When the two Luminous Thornmaws' Grievous Gash (387930 Physical + stacking bleed) starts stacking, use Shield Wall, and use Last Stand the next time it overlaps. Shield Block can't stop the bleed, so keep stacking Ignore Pain.
[탱버] The Grievous Gash bleed only clears at full health, so top yourself off with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health) to help your healer.
[제어] Stop both Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap together with Shockwave (10 yd frontal, 2 sec stun).
8: [탱버] Take Spouting Floret with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain only, and save Shield Wall and Last Stand for Lightwarden Ruia's 40% phase that follows.
10: [탱버] Use Shield Block for Potatoad Matriarch's Tongue Toss (290947 Physical + knock-up). On the Colossus build, channel Demolish as soon as you see the 2 sec cast to take it while immune to forced movement.
[차단] When the two Lightgorged Lashers wrap themselves in the Lightbloom Pollination shield (600108 absorb), throw Wrecking Throw (up to 500% bonus damage to absorbs) to break it fast.
11: [차단] When all three Lightfeather Petalwings cast Disorienting Screech together, interrupt them at once with Disrupting Shout.
[탱버] When Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash overlaps the Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, use Shield Wall; when only Floret comes, take it with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain.
12: [탱버] When the six Lightgorged Lashers pop Lightbloom Pollination, nearby mobs gain 50% attack speed, so keep Shield Block rolling and use Demoralizing Shout together with Shield Wall.
[차단] Interrupt both Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley at once with Disrupting Shout. If it's still on cooldown from pull 11, stop them one at a time with Wrecking Throw and Pummel.
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry (3 min) to raise the party's max health when Spouting Floret and Light Bolt Volley overlap.

1: [제어] When the seven Ravenous Descendants' Ravenous Claws stacks (2 sec each) start to hurt, stun them for 2 sec with Shockwave (40 sec) and Heroic Leap out so the stacks fall off. Bounding Stride gives 70% movement speed for 3 sec after the leap, and adding Piercing Howl (24 yd radius with Battlefield Commander, 70% snare) lets you peel away from them (Topicx).

[차단] Take one Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Pummel (15 sec), and when both cast together, interrupt both with Disrupting Shout within 14 yd. Don't use Shield Wall in this pull; save it for Blood Sacrifice in pull 2.
2: [탱버] Take Ritual Chieftain's Dismember (3 sec cast, 581895 Physical) with Shield Block alone. Topicx (a Protection Warrior) says it barely hurts a Protection Warrior, so don't spend a defensive on it.

[탱버] Spend one Shield Wall charge on Blood Sacrifice (party-wide 87284 Physical + healing absorb), the hardest-hitting ability in this pull. Both M+ builds take Defender's Aegis, so Shield Wall has 2 charges at 2 min each; use the second charge in pull 3 (Topicx).
3: [위치] Tag the three Primal Serpents up top with Heroic Throw (35 yd with Javelineer), then hide behind the pillar so the casters walk down to you (Topicx).
[차단] Once the three Primal Serpents gather in front of the pillar, interrupt their Piercing Hiss all at once with Disrupting Shout and Pummel any remaining cast.
[탱버] Use the second Shield Wall charge you saved in pull 2 on Blood Sacrifice.
4: [탱버] If both Shield Wall charges are on cooldown, use Last Stand (3 min, +30% max health) for Blood Sacrifice. Again take Dismember with Shield Block alone.
5: [탱버] When the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots (Nature DoT) overlap Ritual Chieftain's Blood Sacrifice, use the first Shield Wall charge (back from pull 2) and press Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% less magic damage for 5 sec) with it.
[차단] Split the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss between Pummel and Disrupting Shout. The haste debuff leaves you short on Rage to keep Shield Block up.
7: [탱버] When Rattling Writhe casts Corrosive Fangs (3 sec cast, 242456 Nature + 20% more damage taken for 20 sec), press Spell Reflection to reflect it. Topicx (a Protection Warrior) shows on video that a reflected cast leaves no debuff.
[제어] Stun High Evolutionist's Evolve (6 sec channel) for 4 sec with Storm Bolt and Pummel its Envenom. Stun the three Bloodletters together with Shockwave to stop their melee.
8: [탱버] Reflect every Corrosive Fangs cast with Spell Reflection. It comes back every 25 sec, so you can cover almost every cast.
[제어] Stun all four Bloodletters with Shockwave. On the Mountain Thane build, Rumbling Earth cuts Shockwave's cooldown by 15 sec when it hits 3 or more targets.
9: [탱버] Reflect Corrosive Fangs with Spell Reflection. Topicx admits he missed the reflect in this pull and took the debuff, so watch the cast bar and press it early.
[차단] If no ranged player interrupts the far-left High Evolutionist, stop it with Wrecking Throw (45 sec, 30 yd and a 3 sec silence via Javelineer) to pull it in. Stop Evolve with Storm Bolt.
11: [차단] When the four High Evolutionists cast Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) together, gather them within 14 yd and interrupt them all at once with Disrupting Shout.
[제어] When several start Evolve, stop them together with Shockwave. On the Mountain Thane build, Storm Bolts also stuns 2 nearby targets for 2 sec, but Storm Bolt's cooldown becomes 40 sec.
12: [탱버] Ascendant Serpent's Noxious Spray (3 sec cast, then 67888 Nature every 1 sec for 5 sec with pushback) is not a melee attack, so Shield Block does nothing. On high keys, overlap Spell Reflection and Shield Wall as the cast finishes (Topicx).
[제어] When Infest spawns Hatchlings, stun them all with Shockwave to keep them in one place (Topicx).
13: [차단] Pummel Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom. If Pummel is on cooldown, stop it with a Storm Bolt stun.
[제어] During Toxic Surge (2 sec cast, 9 sec party AoE), stun both Blades of the Altar with Shockwave so they can't teleport with Laced Edge (Topicx).
14: [광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry (3 min, 13 sec with Battlefield Commander) for the 9 sec Toxic Surge AoE (Topicx).
[제어] During Toxic Surge, stun both Blades of the Altar with Storm Bolt and Shockwave so they can't teleport onto party members (Topicx).
15: [차단] Split the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss between Pummel and Disrupting Shout, and stun all four Blades of the Altar with Shockwave.
16: [탱버] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back, so use Shield Wall for the first and Last Stand for the second.
[차단] Pummel Ula'tek's Chosen's Mass Envenom, and lock down both Blades of the Altar with Storm Bolt during Toxic Surge.
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, if Rallying Cry is back from pull 14, use it again on Toxic Surge.

1: [탱버] Shadow-Borne Champion's Shadow Whirlwind (164870 Shadow, 4 sec cast) is not a melee attack, so Shield Block does nothing. When you see the cast, stack Ignore Pain and press Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% less magic damage for 5 sec).

[탱버] When the Champion pops Ancestral Fury (150% more damage), it stacks with both Animated Guardians' hits, so keep Shield Block up and use one Shield Wall charge with Demoralizing Shout (45 sec). Defender's Aegis gives Shield Wall 2 charges, so save the second for the Champion in pull 2.
[제어] Stun the Minion of Zul on the way with Storm Bolt (30 sec, 4 sec stun) to buy time for your party to purge its shield.
2: [차단] Pummel (15 sec) Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT). Warriors can't remove curses, so if Pummel is on cooldown, stop it with Wrecking Throw (3 sec silence via Javelineer).

[탱버] Take Shadow Whirlwind with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain, and use the second Shield Wall charge saved from pull 1 if Ancestral Fury overlaps. The charge used in pull 1 returns about 1 min 48 sec later, so both charges are ready by pull 4 after The Golden Serpent.
4: [탱버] Shield Block can't stop King A'akul's Mortal Bleed (18 sec physical bleed, 20% less healing taken) or Bloodsworn Assassin's Sudden Rupture bleed, so keep Ignore Pain stacked. When you see Blood Drain (164870 Physical, 2.5 sec cast) while bleeding, use Shield Wall; use the second charge on the next Blood Drain and Last Stand (3 min) on the one after.
[차단] Pummel Queen Wasi's Bind Soul (2.5 sec cast, 10 sec charm) first, and stop Soul Bolt or Seneschal M'bara's Unholy Mending with the Wrecking Throw silence.
[제어] Warriors can't purge Guard Captain Atu's Captain's Bulwark (nearby mobs take 30% less damage), so stun it with Storm Bolt when you see the 2.5 sec cast to delay it.
5: [광역 피해] Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 Fire to the whole party) is magic damage, so cut it by 20% with Spell Reflection and back out of the zone with Ignore Pain stacked. On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry (3 min) to raise party max health if your healer falls behind.
6: [차단] Stop the two Half-Finished Mummies' Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, party-wide disease) by Pummeling one and stunning the other with Storm Bolt (4 sec stun). Warriors can't remove diseases, so stop both casts.
7: [차단] Gather both Half-Finished Mummies within 14 yd and interrupt Wretched Discharge on both at once with Disrupting Shout (1.5 min), which also taunts them. If you miss it, stop them one at a time with Pummel and Storm Bolt.
9: [차단] The two Phantom Hex Priests chain-cast Spectral Bolt and Hex (3.5 sec cast, 5 sec polymorph), so when both are within 14 yd, interrupt them at once with Disrupting Shout and pull them in. Split later casts between Pummel and Wrecking Throw, and stop them together with Shockwave (40 sec, 2 sec stun) if the pack is stacked.

[탱버] Shield Block can't stop the two Royal Berserkers' Bloodthirsty Axe bleed (12 sec physical), so stack Ignore Pain and top yourself off with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health). Use only one Shield Wall charge here and save the other for the Ghostly Brute in pull 10.
10: [탱버] Ghostly Brute's Soul Crush (727368 Physical, 2.5 sec cast) makes the target take 30% more physical damage for 15 sec. When you see the cast, use the Shield Wall charge saved from pull 9 and stack Ignore Pain, then cut melee damage for the next 15 sec with Shield Block and Demoralizing Shout. If Shield Wall is down, use Last Stand.
[회피] When you see Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical nearby plus knock-up), leave the area with Heroic Leap (45 sec) and pick the Ghostly Brute back up.
[차단] Pummel the single Phantom Hex Priest. Disrupting Shout from pull 9 has a 1.5 min cooldown and may not be back, so use the Wrecking Throw silence as backup.
12: [탱버] Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage (58190 Shadow plus a 4 sec DoT) goes to whoever engages first, so get there first with Charge or Heroic Leap. Take the first cast with Spell Reflection and later casts with Ignore Pain.

1: [탱버] Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard both cast Shield Bash (3 sec cast, Physical + 20% more physical damage taken for 20 sec), so use Shield Wall when the two casts overlap. Also use a defensive when Heartstop Poison stacks are high (Topicx).
[탱버] Heartstop Poison lowers max health by 5% per stack. Warriors can't dispel poison, so hold out with Last Stand (3 min, +30% max health) as stacks build and call for a dispel.
2: [차단] Of the two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast), Pummel (15 sec) one and stop the other with a Storm Bolt stun. Once the line-of-sighted Felonious Mages are also within 14 yd, interrupt them all with Disrupting Shout.
3: [탱버] Take Bribed Guard's Shield Bash with Shield Block. Topicx says it barely hurts specs with good physical mitigation, so save Shield Wall.
4: [제어] Stun all four Street Sneaks with Shockwave to slow how fast Heartstop Poison stacks. On the Mountain Thane build, Rumbling Earth cuts the cooldown by 15 sec when it hits 3 or more targets.
[탱버] When Heartstop Poison stacks get high, use Shield Wall or Last Stand (Topicx).
5: [탱버] When Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle targets you, reflect it with Spell Reflection (25 sec). The cast can't be interrupted (Topicx).
[차단] The two Felonious Mages' Fel Missiles are channels, so Pummel one, and use Disrupting Shout if both channel together.
8: [차단] Stop the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast) with Pummel and Disrupting Shout. Stop Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with a Storm Bolt stun.

[탱버] The two Trained Felhunters add Shadow Bite shadow damage to every melee hit, so take them with Spell Reflection (20% less magic damage for 5 sec) and Ignore Pain. Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 12 yd Physical) is not a melee attack, so step out past 12 yd.
9: [참고] When Corrupted Warlock wraps itself in Dark Pact at 50%, throw Wrecking Throw (up to 500% bonus damage to absorbs) (Topicx).
[제어] Stun the eight Demon Flies with Shockwave while they are grouped so they can't dash onto party members. Topicx tethers them with Champion's Spear, but that talent is not in Wowhead's M+ builds.
[차단] Pummel the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage.
10: [차단] Pummel Fel Invoker's first Health Funnel and stop the other Invoker with Storm Bolt, then chain-pull the Demon Fly packs (Topicx).
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry (3 min, 13 sec with Battlefield Commander) when Shivan Punisher pulses party fire damage with Demonic Frenzy below 50%.
11: [광역 피해] For Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance (2 sec cast, Fire), cut your own magic damage by 20% with Spell Reflection on one cast, and cover the party with Rallying Cry on another on the Colossus build (Topicx: split personal and party defensives).
[탱버] Take the two Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite damage with Ignore Pain. Turn Lucsei away from the party for the Eye Beam (2.5 sec cast) frontal.
13: [차단] Gather the six Unleashed Imps and two Wrathguard Flayers within 14 yd and interrupt Felfire Burst and Fel Rage all at once with Disrupting Shout.
[탱버] For Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (2 sec cast, 145474 Fire to the party), press Spell Reflection to cut magic damage by 20% and stack Ignore Pain.
14: [차단] Gather the six Unleashed Imps and two Wrathguard Flayers and interrupt them together with Disrupting Shout, then Pummel Fel Invoker's Health Funnel.
[탱버] Take the two Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite damage with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain.
15: [위치] Tag Corrupted Warlock first with Heroic Throw, drag it back and kill it, then handle Shivan Punisher separately. Throw Wrecking Throw into the Dark Pact shield (Topicx).
[탱버] As the three Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite damage stacks up, use Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain, and add Demoralizing Shout and Shield Wall if that isn't enough.
16: [광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry on Defiled Golem's first Defiled Slam, and leave the second Slam to another party member's raid defensive (Topicx).
[차단] Split the two Fel Invokers' Health Funnel between Pummel and Storm Bolt. Take the two Trained Felhunters' Shadow Bite with Spell Reflection.

1: [탱버] When the two Territorial Matriarchs stack Mother's Wrath, warriors have no soothe, so keep Shield Block rolling and cycle Demoralizing Shout (45 sec), Shield Wall, and Last Stand (Topicx).

[탱버] The three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleed and Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery (5 sec Shadow channel) can't be blocked with Shield Block. Stack Ignore Pain, and press Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% less magic damage for 5 sec) for Feast of Misery.
2: [차단] Of Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) and Earth Bolt (2.5 sec cast), Pummel (15 sec) one and stop the other with a Storm Bolt stun or Wrecking Throw (3 sec silence via Javelineer).
[탱버] With only one Matriarch, take it with Shield Block and Demoralizing Shout, and save Shield Wall for the two Matriarchs in pull 7.
3: [차단] Pummel Earthwhisper Tender, and take the Feast of Misery channel with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain.
4: [탱버] As the three Keen-Eyed Strikers' Razor Dive bleeds stack, keep stacking Ignore Pain and top yourself off with Impending Victory (25 sec, heals 30% of max health).
5: [위치] Heroic Leap (Bounding Stride gives 70% movement speed for 3 sec) across to the last berry bush offering, then pull this pack and drag it to the boss spot while the party clicks the barrels (Topicx).
[차단] Pummel Earthwhisper Tender while you drag the pack so it follows you.
7: [위치] Circle the outside clockwise to gather the two casters, tag the bears with Heroic Throw, and fight them in the corner (Topicx).

[탱버] When the two Territorial Matriarchs' enrage stacks build, use one Shield Wall charge, and the second charge or Last Stand when they build again. Both M+ builds take Defender's Aegis, so Shield Wall has 2 charges at 2 min each.
[차단] When both Earthwhisper Tenders cast together, interrupt them at once with Disrupting Shout (1.5 min) within 14 yd.
8: [탱버] The five Frostfangs' Frostbite is Frost damage, so take it with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain rather than Shield Block. Use Shield Block and Shield Wall for the two Territorial Matriarchs' physical damage (Topicx: this pull only hurts the tank).
[참고] Throw Wrecking Throw (up to 500% bonus damage to absorbs) into Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield (Topicx).
9: [탱버] Glacial Revenant deals magic damage with no cast bar, so press Spell Reflection on cooldown. You can hear the sound when it reflects (Topicx).
[차단] Stop the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast) with Pummel and Disrupting Shout, and throw Wrecking Throw into Terra Rumbler's shield (Topicx).
[참고] This is a Bloodlust pull, so use Avatar (1.5 min) with it.
10: [탱버] Against the magic damage from two Glacial Revenants and three Frostfangs, press Spell Reflection on cooldown and stack Ignore Pain (Topicx).
[차단] Pummel the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar one at a time. The cast is 3.5 sec, so you have time to Pummel both.
11: [회피] When you see Avatar of Determination's Pulverize (4 sec cast, 12 yd stun + 387930 Physical), walk out past 12 yd, and Heroic Leap out if you are late.
[참고] If you get caught in Glacial Tomb, stay stacked and use Thunder Clap and Revenge to break the ice around you. Throw Wrecking Throw into Terra Rumbler's shield (Topicx).
[탱버] Press Spell Reflection on cooldown against Glacial Revenant's magic damage (Topicx).
13: [탱버] The two Grizzled Warbringers' Primal Echo (armor-ignoring stacking Physical) can't be blocked with Shield Block. Stack Ignore Pain, and use Shield Wall on high keys (Topicx).
[차단] Of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast), Pummel one and stop the other with Storm Bolt or Wrecking Throw.
14: [차단] Stop the far-off Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Wrecking Throw (30 yd and a 3 sec silence via Javelineer) to pull it in (Topicx).
[탱버] When the three Bonded Beasttamers raise their damage by 25% with Bestial Wrath, keep Shield Block up and layer Demoralizing Shout. If you Bloodlust this pull, use Avatar with it.
15: [탱버] The four Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo, so spend the two Shield Wall charges and Last Stand one at a time, stacking Ignore Pain in between (Topicx).
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry (3 min, 13 sec with Battlefield Commander) to raise the party's max health while Primal Echo stacks (Topicx: a spot for raid defensives).
[차단] When both Stormbound Mystics cast together, interrupt them at once with Disrupting Shout.
16: [차단] Pummel (15 sec) Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt. If Pummel is on cooldown, use Disrupting Shout.
[참고] Use Avatar (1.5 min) when a Volatile Totem wave appears so the totems die before the third wave (Topicx).

1: [탱버] Right after the pull, four Deepstone Earthshapers stack Tectonic Strike (25% more damage taken for 8 sec, stacking) all at once, so have Shield Wall up while you gather. When you see Primal Juggernaut's Crushing Smash (533403 Physical + 145474 Nature, 2.5 sec cast) at 2+ stacks, stack Ignore Pain and use the second Shield Wall charge or Last Stand (3 min).

[제어] If stacks get high, stun the Earthshapers with Shockwave (2 sec frontal stun) and back off so the stacks drop after 8 sec. On the Mountain Thane build, Rumbling Earth cuts Shockwave's cooldown by 15 sec when it hits 3 or more targets.
[차단] While gathering to the doorway, stop the first Flashfrost Chillweaver's cast with Shield Charge (45 sec, 4 sec stun on the target), and always Pummel the Ice Shield channel (15 sec).
2: [탱버] The Shield Wall charge used in pull 1 returns about 1 min 48 sec later, so take this pull's Crushing Smash with the remaining charge or Last Stand plus Ignore Pain. Layer Demoralizing Shout (45 sec) as Tectonic Strike stacks build.
[차단] Pummel Flashfrost Chillweaver's Ice Shield channel, and if Pummel is on cooldown, stop it with Wrecking Throw (3 sec silence via Javelineer).
3: [탱버] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage (1 sec cast, 242456 Physical every 0.5 sec for 3 sec) is a flurry of melee strikes on its target, so keep Shield Block up and rotate one cooldown per cast: Shield Wall, then Demoralizing Shout, then Last Stand. Take the fire nova from each strike (24246) with Ignore Pain.
[차단] Pummel the Ice Shield of the Flashfrost Chillweaver you pulled along so Draghar and the Earthshapers don't get shielded.
5: [탱버] Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast (358835 Fire, 4 sec cast) only targets the tank, so press Spell Reflection (25 sec) before the cast to reflect it. Once you reflect it, your party doesn't need to interrupt the Destroyer, so put their interrupts on the Primalist Cinderweavers. Take any cast that comes while Spell Reflection is on cooldown with Ignore Pain.
[제어] The two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel) can't be interrupted, so stop one with Storm Bolt (30 sec, 4 sec stun) and the other with Shockwave.
[차단] Pummel a Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt once and leave the next cast to your party.
6: [탱버] Flamegullet's Fire Maw (581895 Physical + 96982 Fire, 2.5 sec cast) leaves a 6 sec Fire DoT, so use Shield Wall and stack Ignore Pain. Reflect the Destroyer's Fiery Blast with Spell Reflection so the only damage you take is the Fire Maw and Inferno DoTs.
[제어] When the Ashseer Flamelasher channels Flaming Barrage, stun it with Storm Bolt to stop it.
7: [탱버] Press Spell Reflection before the Destroyer's Fiery Blast to reflect it, and take it with Ignore Pain if Spell Reflection is on cooldown.

[제어] Group the two Ashseer Flamelashers and stop both Flaming Barrage channels with Shockwave, then stop any remaining channel with Storm Bolt. On the Mountain Thane build, Storm Bolts also stuns 2 nearby targets for 2 sec.
8: [탱버] Reflect the Destroyer's Fiery Blast with Spell Reflection. When the Inferno Fire DoT stacks up, use Rallying Cry (3 min) on the Colossus build to raise party max health.
[제어] Split the two Ashseer Flamelashers' Flaming Barrage between Storm Bolt and Shockwave. Both were used in pull 7 but have 30 sec and 40 sec cooldowns, so they are ready again here.
10: [탱버] Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast (387930 Nature, 4 sec cast) only targets the tank, so press Spell Reflection ahead of time to reflect it; your party doesn't need to interrupt the Channeler. Take the six Storm Warriors' Thunderous Stomp (Nature, 60 yd) with Ignore Pain.
[제어] Stun the six Storm Warriors together with Shockwave once they are grouped, and stop the Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Storm Bolt.
11: [탱버] Reflect Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast with Spell Reflection. The only cast to interrupt in this pull is the Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt, so use Pummel on the Cinderweaver.
12: [우선 처치] When High Channeler Ryvati raises Tempest Stormshield (absorbs 20% of its max health), throw Wrecking Throw (up to 500% bonus damage to absorbs) right away to break it. The party takes Nature damage every second while the shield is up.
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry while Tempest Stormshield is up. If you are the Lightning Torrent target (7 sec Nature channel), take it with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain.

1: [탱버] Sandfury Stonefist's Sunder Slam (387930 Physical, 3 sec cast) raises physical damage taken by 50% for 10 sec and stacks, but it is physical, so Shield Block and Ignore Pain handle it (Topicx). Use Shield Wall once stacks reach 3.

[차단] On the left route, stop the first Storm Adept with Wrecking Throw (3 sec silence via Javelineer) so it walks down the stairs. During Ground Pound (4 sec cast), keep the three Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolts from lining up by interrupting all three at once with Disrupting Shout once they are within 14 yd.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with Storm Bolt (30 sec, 4 sec stun).
2: [탱버] Engage the two hidden Shrouded Fangs at the bottom of the stairs first with Charge (20 sec) so you take Poisoned Cheap Shot (5 sec stun and Nature poison DoT). Warriors can't remove poison, so stack Ignore Pain before engaging.
[차단] During Ground Pound, stop the two Storm Adepts' Lightning Bolts one at a time with Pummel and Wrecking Throw. Disrupting Shout from pull 1 has a 1.5 min cooldown and may not be back yet.
4: [탱버] When Lightning Serpent casts Serpent's Stormcall, its melee attacks add Nature damage for 8 sec, so on top of Shield Block take it with Spell Reflection (25 sec, 20% less magic damage for 5 sec) and Ignore Pain.
[차단] Pummel Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Storm Bolt.
5: [탱버] Use Shield Block for Krolusk Matriarch's Head Butt (727368 Physical, 3 sec cast) and layer Ignore Pain. When Serrated Charge bleeds from Barbed Krolusks and Swarming Krolusks adds stack up, use Shield Wall, and use Last Stand (3 min) on the next overlap.
[차단] Gather the two Storm Adepts before the Sand-Sworn Rider, then interrupt both Lightning Bolts at once with Disrupting Shout within 14 yd. Stop later casts with Pummel and Wrecking Throw.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Storm Bolt.
6: [차단] Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind is a 5 sec cast, so the tank can cover it with one Pummel. Add the Wrecking Throw silence to your party's interrupts on the two Brood Tenders' Venom Bolt.
[탱버] When both Lightning Serpents' Serpent's Stormcall are active together, layer Demoralizing Shout (45 sec) on Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain.
7: [탱버] Press Spell Reflection for the 8 sec when both Lightning Serpents' Serpent's Stormcall overlap, and use Shield Wall if the Sand-Sworn Rider joins and your health drops.
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Storm Bolt and Pummel Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind.
9: [광역 피해] Take the two Agitated Nimbuses' Release Charge (145474 Nature to the party, 3 sec cast) with Spell Reflection and Ignore Pain. On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry (3 min) when the two Release Charges land close together.

[차단] So the two Imbued Stormcallers' Lightning Bolts don't slip through while Release Charge goes off, gather them within 14 yd and interrupt both at once with Disrupting Shout. Split later casts between Pummel and Wrecking Throw.
10: [차단] Stop the two Imbued Stormcallers before gathering anything else: one with Pummel and the other with the Wrecking Throw silence.

[탱버] Agitated Nimbus, four Static Anomalies, and two Stormcallers together make this a dangerous pull, so use Shield Wall before the first Release Charge and layer Spell Reflection. Use Last Stand if your health runs low.
12: [탱버] Orb Watcher's Venomous Slash (581895 Physical plus a 10 sec Nature DoT, 2.5 sec cast) is a direct strike on its target, so keep Shield Block up and take the Nature DoT with Ignore Pain. Use Shield Wall on the first cast and Demoralizing Shout on the next.
[제어] Stop the Essence Disruption of the Temple Disruptor on the far side of the orb with Wrecking Throw (30 yd range, 3 sec silence) or Storm Bolt, and Pummel the Disruptor on your side.
13: [탱버] Keep Shield Block and Ignore Pain up for Venomous Slash, and if the Shield Wall charge from pull 12 isn't back yet, use the second charge or Last Stand.
[제어] Stun the far Temple Disruptor with Storm Bolt and Pummel the near Disruptor's channel to protect the orb's charge.
14: [차단] Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock (4 sec cast) is a must-kick on a CC-immune mob, so Pummel it, and if Pummel is on cooldown, interrupt it with Disrupting Shout.
[제어] Slow the four Faithless Tormentors chasing your healer with Piercing Howl (12 yd, 70% slow for 8 sec) and stun them all at once with Shockwave.

1: [차단] As the tank, take the first kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley (4 sec cast, 193965 Shadow within 60 yd) with Pummel (15 sec). If the second kicker misses, back them up with Wrecking Throw (3 sec silence via Javelineer) or Storm Bolt (Topicx).
[위치] Tag the Magi with Heroic Throw, then back off around the corner into the room so the whole hallway follows, and press Avatar (1.5 min) with Bloodlust (Topicx).
[탱버] If you are targeted by Null Eruption, step out of the group and take it with Spell Reflection (20% less magic damage for 5 sec) and Ignore Pain.
2: [탱버] If you enter combat with Raj'kess the Spellstorm first, the first Forked Lightning (2.5 sec cast, Nature) goes on the tank, so reflect it right away with Spell Reflection. Even when it targets someone else it can bounce to you, so press it for every cast (Topicx).
[위치] Close the gaps between the three Orbs of Disruption quickly with Charge (2 charges via Double Time), Heroic Leap, and Shield Charge to help the party kill them (Topicx).
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry (3 min, 13 sec with Battlefield Commander) on the first or second Thundering Storm. It matters more at +17 and above (Topicx).
3: [위치] Gather the room and the mobs that pour in from the side walls quickly with Heroic Leap, Charge, and Heroic Throw. Most mobs here only threaten the tank (Topicx).

[탱버] Reflect Brutok's Head Bash (2.5 sec cast, knockback) with Spell Reflection and you won't be knocked back (Topicx). While Spell Reflection is up, it also blunts Sycophantic Tarasek's Melt Armor stacks.
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (10 sec of Nature damage to the party) (Topicx).
5: [탱버] When you pull the pack at the top of the stairs, reflect Enthralled Shaman's first Lava Bolt (2.5 sec cast, Fire) with Spell Reflection, then drag it to the Watchful Harrower (Topicx).
[차단] Save Pummel for Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd). If it goes off, Berserker Rage (1 min) makes you immune to fear for 6 sec.
6: [참고] When Brutal Overseer raises its Brutal Slams shield, throw Wrecking Throw (up to 500% bonus damage to absorbs) (Topicx).
[광역 피해] On the Colossus build, use Rallying Cry as the Brutal Slams party physical damage ramps, especially when it overlaps Watchful Harrower's Sky Strike soak.
8: [탱버] Devouring Brutalizer always follows Dreadbellow (4.5 sec cast, knockback + 12 sec Shadow DoT) with Brutalize (678877 Physical every 1.5 sec for 6 sec). Take Dreadbellow with Spell Reflection and use Shield Wall and Ignore Pain for Brutalize (Topicx).
[차단] Keep Pummel for Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek. If it goes off, break the fear with Berserker Rage.
[탱버] Each Shred Defense from the three Savage Shredclaws adds 20% damage taken, so keep Shield Block up and use Demoralizing Shout (45 sec) when they overlap.
9: [위치] After the patrolling Devouring Brutalizer passes to the left, Heroic Leap to the Scavenging Siphoids, tag a few, and drag them to the next pack while holding threat (Topicx).
[탱버] Use the second Shield Wall charge on this pull's Brutalize and take Dreadbellow with Spell Reflection. Both M+ builds take Defender's Aegis, so Shield Wall has 2 charges at 2 min each.
10: [탱버] For Brutalize, use the first Shield Wall charge if it is back from pull 8, otherwise use Last Stand (3 min). Take Dreadbellow with Spell Reflection.
[탱버] If you are targeted by Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (4 sec Shadow), step out of the group and stack Ignore Pain if Spell Reflection is on cooldown.
